name: TATMOK Marathon 2027
short_description: TATMOK Marathon 2027 is on Sunday 21 February 2027 at Huai Bong Checkpoint (KM 10), Tat Mok National Park in Phetchabun, over 42 km, 21 km, 10 km and 5 km.
ai_summary: TATMOK Marathon 2027 is organised by the Sports Association of Phetchabun and starts at the Huai Bong Checkpoint (KM 10) of Tat Mok National Park. The organiser route map shows an out-and-back course along the park road, with about 1,088 m of climbing and an 8-hour limit for the marathon. The marathon starts at 03:00 and the half marathon at 05:00, and earlier editions ran each February from 2023 to 2026, according to RUNLAH.

core_facts.venue: Huai Bong Checkpoint (KM 10), Tat Mok National Park

faqs.question: What is the course like at TATMOK Marathon 2027?
faqs.answer: The organiser route map shows the marathon going out and back along the road through Tat Mok National Park from the Huai Bong checkpoint. The map lists about 1,088 m of elevation gain and an 8-hour time limit for the full marathon, with the finish due by 11:00.

faqs.question: How much does TATMOK Marathon 2027 cost?
faqs.answer: Regular entry is THB 1,090 for the full marathon, THB 890 for the half marathon, THB 690 for the 10 km and THB 590 for the 5 km. Charity entries at THB 2,000 include a THB 1,000 donation receipt.
